answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 10121 Country: India Title: What is the significance of salatul haja? how to perform it? Question: What is the significance of salatul haja? how to perform it? Answer ID: 10121 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 128/122=B/1429) When anything important occurs, then praying two rakaah salah and supplicating to Allah is called Salatul Hajah . This causes blessing and benefit, the task is fulfilled and one is protected against harms and loss. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
